_about: Game systems the mod adds. One row = one Papyrus script / quest stage group.

rows.name: Merc Market
rows.description: Organizer offers the hireable mercs available this season; hire costs signingFee caps.

rows.name: Weekly Wages
rows.description: Every 7 in-game days, each merc's wage is taken from player caps; unpaid mercs leave.

rows.name: League & Table
rows.description: Round-robin fixtures, 3 pts win / 1 draw, table shown via message box at the organizer.

rows.name: Match Day
rows.description: Pick lineup + tactic, player is moved to the stands, both squads spawn in the cage and fight; last squad standing wins, timeout = draw. Rival-vs-rival results are simulated by strength.

rows.name: Merc Progression
rows.description: XP per match, level-ups raise health/damage and wage; injuries bench a merc for N matches.

rows.name: Knockout Cup
rows.description: Mid-season single-elimination cup between all clubs; winner gets cupPrize.

rows.name: Poaching Offers
rows.description: After a season, a rival offers caps for your highest-level merc; accept or refuse.
